gaps.name: restaurant_door and restaurant_window: flat sheets a library finish cannot match to their close-ups
gaps.reason: Their Pixal3D takes made no model, so each is a flat-sheet code build (score/stages/props/flat_sheet.py) laid as its close-up's outline at the row's size and finished with a plain library surface; DINOv2 cannot score a flat slab as like a close-up of a glass door or window (0.084 and 0.037 under 0.14, the PC run of 2026-11-10), and a sheet's retake is the same flat build again, so it would fail the same way. The same cause as quarters' rug (5e0c189c): ships as a named gap under the owner's rule of 2026-11-09 until a library surface and a sheet build that can carry glass land.
gaps.decided: the owner's rule of 2026-11-09 ("EVERY FAIL GETS ONE PAID RETAKE, IF FAIL AGAIN, GAP"), applied by the env1 run session as for quarters' rug, 2026-11-10 ~03:45 UTC
